author: barnabasbusa
content:
It's a CL sync bug, not an EL one. The buildoor's Lodestar beacon node can't range-sync, so the buildoor sits on a chain that's 20k slots stale. Its deposit transactions time out, it never registers, and its stats stay at zero.

What the buildoor page shows (api/status, api/stats): it's running, but current_slot: 0 and is_registered: false. It has tried every 5 minutes since Oct 2 to submit its deposit, and each attempt fails with transaction confirmation timeout. That's expected, because its EL is stuck at block 5225 (0x1469).

Why it's a CL bug:
- The EL kept up the whole time. During the genesis sync on Oct 2, Nethermind returned Valid for every payload Lodestar sent. It stops at 5225 only because Lodestar stopped sending payloads. Its own log says Not receiving ForkChoices from the consensus client.
- Lodestar's sync died on its own. It restarted from genesis at 12:58, synced at about 9 slots/s up to head 5375 at 13:32, then slowed to 0 over about two minutes. Peers were steady at 6–11 and there were no errors at info level. Slot 5375 is the last slot of epoch 167.
- Checkpoint sync didn't fix it. At 13:58 it was checkpoint-synced to slot 7968, which is canonical: same root as lodestar-ethrex-1 and teku-besu-1. Since then it has fetched zero blocks with 10 peers. The EL still shows syncing(0) because the CL has never sent it anything after the anchor.
- The common factor is Lodestar. bootnode-1 runs Lodestar with ethrex and is stuck the same way, at 7648. Its ethrex restarted at 12:56 on Oct 2, it fell behind, and it never caught up. Both ELs are healthy; both stuck nodes need range sync. The other Lodestar nodes are fine because they never fell behind and just follow gossip.

author: barnabasbusa
content:
1. Lodestar's range sync deadlocks on missing data columns (the requesting side).
All four local Lodestar nodes are stuck on the same batch: slots 28096–28127, held up only by slot 28122's data columns.
- cl-1 (besu): needs columns 39 and 70.
- cl-2 (ethrex): needs 31, 69, 70 and 107.
- cl-3 (nethermind): needs 3 and 85.
- cl-4 (reth): needs only column 3.

Every node does the same thing:
1. It downloads all 32 blocks and envelopes fine. Only some columns come back, and peers answer DOWNLOAD_BY_RANGE_ERROR_MISSING_COLUMNS slot=28122.
2. It logs Partially downloaded batch by range. Attempting another round of downloads … status=AwaitingDownload.
3. Then nothing. The last sync activity on every node was at about 09:14:20, and the batch sits at AwaitingDownload with downloadAttempts=0.

So once each peer that claims to custody those columns has failed once, Lodestar doesn't retry, doesn't penalize the peer, and doesn't fail the batch. Sync stays stuck while still reporting 11 peers. cl-2 also logged Block error slot=28096 … No block for root 0x89b8… 137 times. That's a second problem at the anchor block, and I haven't dug into it.

2. Remote Lodestar nodes advertise columns they don't store (the serving side).
The peers returning MISSING_COLUMNS are all five remote Lodestar nodes. They advertise custodyGroupCount=100, but lodestar-besu-1 returns dataColumnSidecars not found in db for slot=28122 … blobs=9, meaning it stores no columns at all for a canonical slot with 9 blobs. The Teku nodes do have that slot. teku-reth-1 has its 69 columns, and the local Teku nodes imported it with their 4 custody columns (cl-7 has column 3, the one cl-4 is waiting for). I stopped the wider scan of how many slots have these gaps, since you wanted me on the enclave.
